indications.description: Recurrent, advanced or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma in patients unsuitable for combination chemotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Methotrexate 40 mg/m² by intravenous bolus on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, until progression or unacceptable toxicity. There is no scheduled Day-22 dose. The clinician may increase to 50 mg/m² only if there has been no mucositis.
treatment.duration_text: Continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity
